data.name: Zapp
data.detailed_description:
ZAPP is a open-world adventure game, where you need to survive as a robot. You and your trusted companion are trapped between the sea and the sky. You will need to upgrade your airship to reach new heights. By gathering materials in the sea you build new platforms and enhance your equipment, fight rogue drones and try to explore the endless world of ZAPP.

EXPLORATION

In order to explore the skies, you will need to gather enough resources for your ascend. Luckily the sea has everything you need.

Use different gadgets and upgrade modules to expand your move set. Moving through the skies will quickly become second nature to you.

BUILDING

There are many dangers waiting for you. Defending your airship should be your highest priority. Extend your small starting platform, to a respectable flying fortress.

data.short_description: Steampunk robots, drones and ... your airship zappeli? In ZAPP you play as a robot who tries to explore the dangerous unknowns. Work your way up from the deepest depths and conquer the skies. BUT be aware, you might not be welcome.

  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 / Intel® Arc™ A580 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070
